_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for itinerary-artifact stripping. Both the CommonJS server (server/src/utils/itineraryArtifacts.js) and the ESM frontend (next-frontend/src/utils/itineraryArtifacts.js) implement stripItineraryArtifacts() and MUST produce identical `content` and `artifactTypes` for every case below. Divergence fails CI in one suite. Do not edit one stripper without updating these fixtures and re-running BOTH suites.

cases.name: plain content with no artifacts is unchanged
cases.input: Here is your plan for Zion. Start early at the Narrows.

expected.content: Here is your plan for Zion. Start early at the Narrows.

cases.name: unterminated opening marker (token-limit truncation) is removed to end
orphan closing marker is removed
cases.input:
Some prose that got mangled.[/ITINERARY_JSON]

More prose.

expected.content:
Some prose that got mangled.

More prose.

cases.name: fenced json labeled itinerary block is removed
bare ITINERARY_JSON label line is removed
cases.input:
Here is the plan.
ITINERARY_JSON:
rest of text

expected.content:
Here is the plan.
rest of text

cases.name: excess blank lines collapse without counting as an artifact
leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed on both ends
complete block plus a trailing orphan close both removed
